waves.author: agent:migration-planner

entry_criteria.statement: Every workload in the wave has an approved target decision.
entry_criteria.verification_method: dbmodernize validate-scenario, plus the approval ledger

entry_criteria.statement: No workload in the wave has an open blocking finding.
entry_criteria.verification_method: dbmodernize assess re-run against current evidence

entry_criteria.statement: The rollback path has been rehearsed in a non-production environment.
entry_criteria.verification_method: Rehearsal record attached to the wave as evidence

exit_criteria.statement: All blocking validation checks pass and none is left un-run.
exit_criteria.verification_method: dbmodernize render-report against the wave validation report

exit_criteria.statement: Business and application owners have accepted the outcome.
exit_criteria.verification_method: Approval artifacts recorded in the ledger

exit_criteria.statement: Monitoring, alerting, and the operational runbook are live and owned.
exit_criteria.verification_method: Operations owner sign-off with links to the alert rules

exit_criteria.statement: Lessons from the pilot are recorded and the plan for later waves is updated to reflect them.
exit_criteria.verification_method: Updated migration plan artifact referencing the pilot report

waves.name: Wave 1 - pilot
waves.objective: Prove the migration method, the validation gate, and the rollback path on the lowest-risk workloads before anything else moves.
prerequisites: Landing zone readiness check passes for the subscriptions in scope.
A non-production environment exists that mirrors the target configuration.
